schema.content:
Table "customers" {
  "customerNumber" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "customerName" TEXT [not null]
  "contactLastName" TEXT [not null]
  "contactFirstName" TEXT [not null]
  "phone" TEXT [not null]
  "addressLine1" TEXT [not null]
  "addressLine2" TEXT
  "city" TEXT [not null]
  "state" TEXT
  "postalCode" TEXT
  "country" TEXT [not null]
  "salesRepEmployeeNumber" INTEGER
  "creditLimit" REAL
}

Table "employees" {
  "employeeNumber" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "lastName" TEXT [not null]
  "firstName" TEXT [not null]
  "extension" TEXT [not null]
  "email" TEXT [not null]
  "officeCode" TEXT [not null]
  "reportsTo" INTEGER
  "jobTitle" TEXT [not null]
}

Table "offices" {
  "officeCode" TEXT [pk, not null]
  "city" TEXT [not null]
  "phone" TEXT [not null]
  "addressLine1" TEXT [not null]
  "addressLine2" TEXT
  "state" TEXT
  "country" TEXT [not null]
  "postalCode" TEXT [not null]
  "territory" TEXT [not null]
}

Table "orderdetails" {
  "orderNumber" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "productCode" TEXT [pk, not null]
  "quantityOrdered" INTEGER [not null]
  "priceEach" REAL [not null]
  "orderLineNumber" INTEGER [not null]
}

Table "orders" {
  "orderNumber" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "orderDate" DATE [not null]
  "requiredDate" DATE [not null]
  "shippedDate" DATE
  "status" TEXT [not null]
  "comments" TEXT
  "customerNumber" INTEGER [not null]
}

Table "payments" {
  "customerNumber" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "checkNumber" TEXT [pk, not null]
  "paymentDate" DATE [not null]
  "amount" REAL [not null]
}

Table "productlines" {
  "productLine" TEXT [pk, not null]
  "textDescription" TEXT
  "htmlDescription" TEXT
  "image" BYTEA
}

Table "products" {
  "productCode" TEXT [pk, not null]
  "productName" TEXT [not null]
  "productLine" TEXT [not null]
  "productScale" TEXT [not null]
  "productVendor" TEXT [not null]
  "productDescription" TEXT [not null]
  "quantityInStock" INTEGER [not null]
  "buyPrice" REAL [not null]
  "MSRP" REAL [not null]
}



Ref: "employees"."reportsTo" > "employees"."employeeNumber"

Ref: "employees"."officeCode" > "offices"."officeCode"

Ref: "customers"."salesRepEmployeeNumber" > "employees"."employeeNumber"

Ref: "orders"."customerNumber" > "customers"."customerNumber"

Ref: "payments"."customerNumber" > "customers"."customerNumber"

Ref: "products"."productLine" > "productlines"."productLine"
